verdict.rationale: SOSPortal is an account-based filing portal, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows only per-filing retrieval from My Submissions and paid ordering of individual copies or certificates. There is no documented bulk export of all account data in open formats, and no account-exit path. These are adjacent retrieval features, not the export-and-leave capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
